description_en: A hard rectangular rattan-shell suitcase on an internal frame with four small wheels, plain telescoping handle and zipper rim. Canonical front: a broad woven shell with leather corner guards. Side view: a carry handle, perimeter zipper and two wheels. Rear view: the recessed telescoping-handle rails and lower wheels. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
